verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server (`edge0 serve`) and a curl example. Nothing in the pack mentions token streaming, SSE, `stream: true`, or incremental output. The serving endpoint is an adjacent capability, and the evidence never shows that generated tokens are streamed back as they are produced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
